title: Happy pig

  <circle cx='61.5' cy='34.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- happy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='46' r='4' fill='#ff8fb0'/>
